mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, model, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM ai_audit_log GROUP BY month, model ORDER BY month DESC, model

SELECT a.id, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, a.model AS model, a.stage AS stage, a.project_id AS projectId, a.prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, a.completion_tokens AS completionTokens, a.total_tokens AS totalTokens, a.latency_ms AS latencyMs, a.cost AS cost, a.success AS success, a.error_message AS errorMessage FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{q.size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(a.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(a.latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatency FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id

SELECT a.model AS model, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY totalTokens DESC

SELECT a.stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
GROUP BY a.stage ORDER BY totalTokens DESC

SELECT a.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM ai_audit_log a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
GROUP BY a.user_id, u.username ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 10
